7921: Sit facing a low cable and hold the handle with one hand.
Rest your elbow near your side.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your set.
7922: Sit upright with a low cable handle in one hand.
Curl up toward your shoulder without leaning back.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower under control, then switch arms.
7994: Lie on your back holding dumbbells at chest level, knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower with control while holding your hips high.
Finish your reps, then lower your hips.
7995: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Raise both arms forward and up at about 45 degrees to form a Y.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower the weights slowly under control.
Keep your neck long and avoid swinging your torso.
7999: Set up on a 45 degree hip extension bench with the band anchored under your feet and held across your upper back.
Cross your arms or hold the band at your shoulders.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to come back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Do not over-arch your lower back at the top.
